essence: The primordial goddess can be propitiated by chanting regardless of observance of fixed rules.
A mortal endowed with brahman-knowledge is liberated while living without doubt.
The practice of primordial Kālī is easy for practitioners to accomplish.
In this practice, purification of mind itself is the fruit-giving result for mantra practitioners.
One endowed with devotion to Kula should continue performing action for as long as appropriate.
